entities.name: FGFR2
observations: Cord-blood DNA methylation at three CpGs was reported associated with high birth-weight centile in a human cohort. PMID:25431941.

entities.name: PMID:25431941
observations: Epigenomics (2014): reported associations of cord-blood FGFR2 methylation at three CpGs with high birth-weight centile (>85th); p=0.004–0.027. Discovery cohort n=12; pyrosequencing investigation cohort n=110.

entities.name: FGFR2 methylation-high birth centile
observations: Human cord-blood study found significant association of methylation at three FGFR2 CpGs with high birth-weight centile (>85th; p=0.004–0.027); investigation cohort n=110. The reported endpoint was birth-weight centile, not explicitly macrosomia or large-for-gestational-age.
